text_block_list.text:
—The Arima Kinen is a festival.
A grand fireworks show to close out the year in style.
As the end of the year approaches, not only the Umamusume running, but also the fans grow more impassioned by the day, their hopes for the Arima Kinen swelling.
And then one day, the results of the preliminary fan poll were announced—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm in 1st place! Trainer!
Everyone voted me as number one!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, and look, look!
There are so many comments from fans, too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I can't wait to see your fierce run in the Arima Kinen!"
"I've been cheering for you ever since the Oka Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
“‘I'm looking forward to a run even greater than the Tenno Sho (Autumn).’
‘Please win as Vodka's rival.’”

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted Vodka to run, but since she's
sitting this one out, I voted for her rival instead."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...'Daiwa Scarlet, please make sure
to seize victory for Vodka's sake, too.'

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! What are you worrying about?
There isn't a single problem, is there?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's troubling, isn't it?
Having that person's presence constantly hanging over you, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: The one who won the Tenno Sho (Autumn) was me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'm also the one
who's expected to take 1st place in the Arima."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I'm Scarlet, the one who surpassed Vodka.
Losing here is simply unacceptable.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, what's with that?
You're sounding so anxious.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's head to training.
We need to make our final adjustments for the Arima, right?

And Daiwa Scarlet headed onto the track,
her expression remaining somewhat stiffâ

"Around that time,
rumors were heard that the date had been set
for Vodka's next overseas expedition."
...And also that today is that day.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...?
Trainer, what's wrong?
choice_data_list: Are you sure you don't need someone to see you off?
Are you sure you don't want a send-off?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, you mean Vodka?
Fine by me."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
We've seen each other face-to-face plenty of times before.
There's nothing left to meet and talk about now.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, isn't the joint press conference this afternoon?
We need to get you in peak condition quickly—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Did you hear, did you hear?! Scarlet!!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Teio? Why are you in such a rush?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You know, Vodka did something...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even though you went all the way to the airport today,
you decided not to board the plane?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...What on earth is she doing...?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Scarlet!?
Where are you going in such a rush—!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: U-Ummm...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Trainer!?
What are you doing in a place like this!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Idiot.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then you search over there!
I'll take a look around here!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If you find Vodka,
call me right away, got it?!

And dashing all around the airport
together with Daiwa Scarletâ

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Ouch!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Whaaat!?
Why the heck are you guys here!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's my line!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"After all your talk about 'going overseas'!
Why the heck are you backing out now?!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm running in an Arima Kinen without you in it!
And because you're not there, I'm going to win it all the more!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you're not in Japan!
The greatest rival you could never beat is right here!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I promised I'd show them what it's like to keep
taking first place in style! That's what I decided, and yet...!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If you're just gonna wander around there,
what was the point of me bracing myself?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wh-What are you laughing at?! I'm being serious here?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my bad, my bad.
The reason I can't make it today is...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like there was an equipment issue with the plane.
So, the departure date got pushed back.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hah!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, so that's why my notifications haven't stopped buzzing.
Everyone's completely misunderstanding, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, man. Calling yourself "my greatest rival"
...is quite a bold declaration coming from you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: “Still, Scarlet. Your real goal is different, isn't it?”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It means becoming the kind of existence where whenever someone hears "Umamusume,"
"Daiwa Scarlet" is the very first name that pops into their head, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Though if you're gonna weep and wail like that,
there's no way you're ever gonna take first place, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Guess I got no choice. Guess I'll drop the overseas trip and run the Arima Kinen instead. That way, I won't have to stress myself out over it, right?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
In exchange, I'm the one who's gonna be number one, though!
Well, you don't mind, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ………………What are you even talking about?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd ever hand over "number one" to you!
I'm the number one Umamusume here!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haha. That's Scarlet for you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Give it your best shot.
...See ya around sometime.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Same to you. Don't you dare go losing
to anyone other than me, dummy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Ah-ah, somehow I'm totally exhausted
even before the press conference.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Really, it's all her fault.
choice_data_list: You got me right till the end.
We got completely outplayed right till the end, huh.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
We will now begin the press conference!
If you have a question, please raise your—

text_block_list.name: Press Crew
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Daiwa Scarlet!!
You've entered as the number one voted favorite this time, but...

text_block_list.name: Press Crew
text_block_list.text:
With your rival Vodka sitting this one out,
how do you feel about being voted in at number one?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, of course I do.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Whether Vodka runs or not, I will become the number one Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Once everyone sees me at the Arima Kinen,
they'll completely forget about Vodka and all the other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I want to show a run so magnificent and memorable
in the Arima Kinen.
Because I'm—"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Because I'm the number one Umamusume, Daiwa Scarlet!

Daiwa Scarlet's confident declaration
graced the front page of the newspaper the following day.

Seeing that, she offered a smile,
never losing her usual bold composure.
